_about: How a player earns each companion but Aki. The server decides from what it already knows and keeps the unlock for good; clients only show the condition and the progress `GET /api/unlocks/{user}` answers. `kind` is what counts: `level` (the player's level), `study_hours` (whole hours studied in total), `streak` (days in a row), `taps` (taps in a row on the companion `requires` names, in the companion picker, once that one is unlocked: the client reports the run that unlocked it with `POST /api/unlocks/{user}`, and the server checks it against the tap rule; `goal` equals `taps`), `leeches_tamed` (cards with at least 8 lapses that later reached a 21-day interval, each card counted once). `goal` is the value that unlocks. A `secret` companion stays hidden until earned; the others show as a locked card with their condition. `status` is `live` when the companion can be earned, `planned` while it has no art yet: servers and clients ignore planned ones. Each check is a measured value of the companion's `kind` and whether it unlocks; the server (src/companions.rs) tests against them, planned companions included. The tap rule: `taps` taps on the `requires` companion in a row, each at most `max_gap_ms` after the one before; a tap on another choice, or a longer gap, starts the count again (a late tap counts as the first of a new run). Each case lists the taps as [choice, milliseconds] and whether the last one unlocks.

cases.name: a gap of exactly max_gap_ms still counts
the late tap is the first of the new run
a tap on another choice starts again
taps on other choices never unlock
